objective: Subitise up to 5: see how many dots, fingers or objects there are without counting
visualModel: Dot cards, dice faces, five-frame flashes
masteryCheck: Flash 4 dots for 1 second; child says 4 without counting
source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
animation: A handful of dots appears for one second then hides. On replay, the dots slide into a familiar shape (a dice 4) so the eye sees the group at once.
interaction: Taps the number of fingers that matches the flash; can hold to see it again.

objective: Count objects one-to-one up to 10 and know the last number said tells how many (cardinality)
visualModel: Counters moved one at a time into a line
masteryCheck: After counting 8 bears, answers 'how many?' with 8 without recounting
animation: Each bear hops into a line as a number pops above it. On the last bear the number grows big and a lasso wraps the whole group: that number is how many.
interaction: Drags bears one by one into a line, then taps the total.

objective: Say the counting sequence to 20 and beyond; start counting from a number other than 1
masteryCheck: Counts on from 6 to 15 without restarting at 1
source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
animation: A frog hops along a numbered path, each square lighting up as it lands. Then it starts on 6 instead of 1 and carries on without going back.
interaction: Hops the frog forward from a given start number.

objective: Recognise numerals 0-10 and match each to a quantity
masteryCheck: Matches 7 to a set of seven objects
animation: A numeral card flies to the group with the same number of objects; the objects pulse once each as they are counted.
interaction: Drags numeral cards onto matching groups.

objective: Compare two groups up to 10: more, fewer, the same, by matching as well as counting
visualModel: Two rows of counters lined up side by side
masteryCheck: Says which row has more when one row is spread out wider
source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
animation: Two rows of cars line up one-to-one; the extra cars in the longer row are left without a partner and glow.
interaction: Pairs up objects between two rows to decide which has more.

objective: Find one more and one less than a number to 10
masteryCheck: Says one less than 7 is 6 instantly
animation: A cube staircase: one cube drops on top to make one more, then lifts off for one less; the step heights show the change.
interaction: Adds or removes one cube and names the new number.

objective: Understand that a quantity stays the same when it is moved or spread out (conservation)
visualModel: Counters rearranged in front of the child
masteryCheck: Knows 6 counters in a circle is still 6 without recounting
animation: Six counters in a line spread into a big circle and then squeeze into a tight clump, with the count 6 staying fixed above them.
interaction: Moves counters around, then predicts the number before checking.

objective: See numbers to 5 as made of smaller parts (part-whole): 5 is 4 and 1, 3 and 2
masteryCheck: Shows 5 as two parts in two different ways
source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
animation: Five counters sit in the whole circle, then slide apart into two part circles (4 and 1, then 3 and 2), then slide back together.
interaction: Splits 5 counters into two parts in different ways.

objective: Recall number bonds to 5 automatically
masteryCheck: Answers 'I have 2, how many more to make 5?' within 3 seconds
source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
animation: A five-frame shows 2 counters; the empty spaces glow and 3 ghost counters fade in to fill it.
interaction: Fills the empty spaces and says how many were missing.

objective: Recall some bonds to 10, including doubles to 5+5
source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
animation: Identical towers of counters appear side by side like a mirror image: double 4 is two matching rows of 4 on a ten-frame.
interaction: Builds doubles on a ten-frame and matches them to totals.

objective: Act out adding to and taking away from small groups in stories
masteryCheck: Solves '3 ducks, 2 more come, how many?' with objects
animation: Three ducks swim on a pond, two more paddle in, and the scene freezes into counters on a mat.
interaction: Acts out add-to and take-away stories with objects.

objective: Share objects fairly into equal groups and spot when a share is unfair
masteryCheck: Shares 6 grapes between 2 plates and checks they are fair
source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
animation: Grapes deal out one at a time to each plate in turn, round and round, until all are shared; plates are then compared side by side.
interaction: Deals objects onto plates and checks fairness.

objective: Explore odd and even by pairing objects
masteryCheck: Says 7 cubes cannot all be paired up
source: EYFS Early Learning Goal (end of Reception)
animation: Socks pair up two by two in a line; with an odd number, one sock is left alone and wiggles.
interaction: Pairs objects and sorts numbers into 'all paired' or 'one left over'.

objective: Copy, continue and create repeating patterns (ABAB, ABB, ABC)
animation: Beads slide onto a string in a pattern; the repeating unit gets a soft bracket and then copies itself along the string.
interaction: Continues the pattern and creates their own.

objective: Name and describe familiar 2D and 3D shapes; build pictures from shapes
visualModel: Pattern blocks, tangram pieces, junk modelling
masteryCheck: Makes a house from a square and a triangle
animation: Shapes glide together to build a house; then one triangle flips and turns to fit a gap.
interaction: Drags shapes to fill a picture outline.

objective: Use position words: in front, behind, on top, under, next to, between
visualModel: Hide-and-find games, Bee-Bot style floor robot
masteryCheck: Places a toy between two others on instruction
animation: A cat moves on, under, behind and between boxes, and each position word lights up as the cat lands.
interaction: Moves the cat to the spoken position.

objective: Compare length, weight and capacity directly: longer, heavier, holds more
visualModel: Balance scale, cups of water, ribbons
masteryCheck: Uses a balance to say which of two objects is heavier
animation: Two objects drop onto a balance and it tips; two ribbons line up at the same starting edge to show which is longer.
interaction: Compares two objects on the balance or by lining them up.

objective: Sequence daily events with before, after, first, then, next
animation: Picture cards of the day slide into order on a timeline from sunrise to bedtime.

objective: Explain an idea in their own words when asked 'how do you know?'
masteryCheck: Gives a reason, not just an answer
animation: A friendly character shows an answer, then rewinds and shows how they know with objects.
interaction: Records a spoken or drawn 'how I know'.

objective: Count to and across 100, forwards and backwards, from any number
masteryCheck: Counts back from 63 to 48 without slips
animation: A spotlight walks across the hundred square; at 39 to 40 it jumps to the next row, showing the decade change. Then it walks backwards.
interaction: Counts forwards and backwards by tapping the next square.

objective: Count in 2s, 5s and 10s
animation: Pairs of shoes, hands of 5 and ten-frames appear in rows while the matching numbers on the hundred square light up in a pattern.
interaction: Taps the next number in the count and watches the pattern grow.

objective: Read and write numerals to 100 and number words to 20
animation: A number word floats up and morphs into its numeral, with the matching quantity in ten-frames below.

objective: See teen numbers as ten and some more (13 = 10 + 3)
visualModel: Full ten-frame plus loose counters, rekenrek
masteryCheck: Builds 16 as a full ten and 6 without counting in ones
animation: 13 counters fall in; ten fill one frame exactly and then glow as one block, and the extra 3 sit in the next frame. The label morphs: 10 and 3, then 13.
interaction: Builds teen numbers as a full ten and some more.

objective: Find one more and one less than any number to 100
animation: A number on the hundred square grows a +1 arrow to the right and a -1 arrow to the left, wrapping at row ends.
interaction: Taps one more and one less of a target number.

objective: Show numbers with objects and on a number line; use equal to, more than, less than, most, least
masteryCheck: Places 12 and 17 on a 0-20 line and says which is more
animation: Two towers of cubes slide onto a number line at their numbers; the taller one is further along.
interaction: Places numbers on a line and compares them.

objective: Subitise structured quantities up to 10 (ten-frame, dice, finger patterns)
animation: A ten-frame flashes 7 as a full row of 5 and 2 more; on replay the full row glows to show 5 and 2.
interaction: Says the flashed number and shows it on the bead frame in one push.

objective: Know all number bonds to 10 fluently, in both orders
masteryCheck: Answers 10 = 6 + ? within 3 seconds, for every pair
animation: A ten-frame holds 6 red; the 4 empty spaces fill with yellow. Then the frame flips through all bonds of 10 like a flip-book.
interaction: Fills the frame to 10 and finds the missing part.

objective: Know and derive number bonds within 20 (14 = 9 + 5)
animation: 9 and 5 sit on double ten-frames; one counter jumps across to fill the first ten, leaving 10 and 4.
interaction: Uses a known fact to solve a teen bond.

objective: Read, write and interpret statements using +, - and =
masteryCheck: Writes a number sentence for a picture story
animation: A picture story plays, then each object turns into a symbol: the groups become numbers, joining becomes +, the total becomes = and a number.
interaction: Builds a number sentence from a picture by dragging symbols.

objective: Add and subtract one-digit and two-digit numbers within 20, including zero
masteryCheck: Solves 15 - 7 with a strategy, not counting all
animation: 15 sits on ten-frames; 7 counters fly away, first 5 from the loose part, then 2 from the full ten.
interaction: Solves the problem on the model, then types it.

objective: Use the make-ten strategy to add across 10 (8 + 5 = 8 + 2 + 3)
visualModel: Two ten-frames, cherry split diagram (Japanese sakuranbo keisan)
animation: 8 and 5 sit on two frames. The 5 splits on a cherry diagram into 2 and 3; the 2 slides over to complete the ten; the full ten glows; the answer is 10 + 3 = 13.
interaction: Splits the second number on a cherry and drags the part that makes ten.

objective: Subtract back through 10 (13 - 5 = 13 - 3 - 2) or from 10 (13 - 5 = 10 - 5 + 3)
animation: 13 on frames. Take away 5: the 5 splits into 3 and 2; first 3 leave to reach exactly 10, then 2 more; a hop on the number line mirrors each step.
interaction: Splits the number to subtract and hops back to 10 first.

objective: Solve missing-number problems such as 7 = ? - 9
animation: A part-whole model with one part hidden behind a question mark; the whole and the known part pull apart to reveal the gap.
interaction: Finds the hidden part by moving counters.

objective: Understand = as 'has the same value as', not 'the answer comes next'
visualModel: Balance scale, equations written both ways round
animation: 5 + 3 sits on one pan and 8 on the other, and the beam levels. Then 4 + 4 replaces 8 and it stays level: both sides have the same value.
interaction: Loads both sides and makes the balance level.

objective: Solve one-step word problems by drawing them, including a simple bar model
masteryCheck: Draws a bar for 'Sam has 6, Ali has 3 more'
animation: Sam's 6 apples line up and shrink into a bar; Ali's apples line up beside them, longer by 3, and become a longer bar.
interaction: Draws bars from objects and labels the parts.

objective: Solve one-step multiplication and division problems using objects, pictures and arrays
masteryCheck: Makes 3 groups of 4 and finds the total
animation: Eggs drop into 3 rows of 4 in a box; each row lights up in turn as the count goes 4, 8, 12.

objective: Double and halve numbers to 20
animation: A mirror slides beside 7 counters and creates a copy; then a group of 14 splits down the middle into two equal halves.
interaction: Doubles with the mirror and halves by splitting.

objective: Recognise a half as one of two equal parts of a shape, object or quantity
masteryCheck: Says whether a shape is cut into halves or not
animation: A paper square folds in half; the two halves lie exactly on top of each other. An unequal cut does not match and wobbles.
interaction: Folds and cuts shapes, then checks if the parts match.

objective: Recognise a quarter as one of four equal parts
animation: A pizza is cut in half and then half again; four equal slices spread apart and one lights up.
interaction: Cuts shapes and groups into four equal parts.

objective: Compare, describe and measure length, mass, capacity and time, starting with non-standard units
masteryCheck: Measures a book in cubes and compares two books
animation: Cubes snap along a pencil one by one, counting up; the same cubes then measure a book.

objective: Recognise UK coins and notes and their values
animation: Coins grow to show their value as small stacks of 1p coins (5p becomes 5 pennies).
interaction: Sorts coins and picks a named coin.

objective: Know days of the week, months and seasons; sequence events
animation: A week strip rolls like a wheel; the days cycle back to Monday. Seasons orbit around a year circle.
interaction: Puts days and months in order on the wheel.

objective: Tell the time to the hour and half past; draw the hands
masteryCheck: Sets a clock to half past 3
animation: The minute hand sweeps a full circle while the hour hand steps to the next number; half past shows the minute hand painting half the face.
interaction: Turns the hands to the hour or half past.

objective: Recognise and name 2D shapes (rectangle, square, circle, triangle) and 3D shapes (cuboid, cube, pyramid, sphere)
masteryCheck: Finds the cube from a feely bag by touch
animation: A cube spins, then its faces peel off and lie flat as squares; a sphere rolls and a cube does not.
interaction: Sorts shapes and solids and matches faces.

objective: Describe position, direction and movement, including whole, half, quarter and three-quarter turns
masteryCheck: Turns a quarter turn on instruction
animation: An arrow turns quarter, half, three-quarter and whole turns, leaving a coloured sweep showing how much of the circle was turned.
interaction: Turns an object by the spoken amount.

objective: Spot and continue number patterns on a hundred square
animation: Counting in 5s paints the hundred square and the painted squares form two straight columns.

objective: Draw a picture of a problem and explain thinking using 'because'
masteryCheck: Explains an answer with a drawing
animation: A word problem is acted out; the scene freezes and is redrawn as a simple sketch beside the answer.
interaction: Draws the problem with simple shapes.

objective: Count in steps of 2, 3 and 5 from 0, and in 10s from any number
animation: A kangaroo hops in 3s along a number line, leaving jump arcs; counting in 10s from 23 slides straight down the hundred square.
interaction: Predicts where the next hop lands.

objective: Know the value of each digit in a two-digit number; partition in different ways (34 = 30 + 4 = 20 + 14)
visualModel: Base-10 blocks, place-value counters, arrow cards
animation: 34 is built from 3 rods and 4 cubes. One rod breaks into 10 cubes, making 2 rods and 14 cubes: still 34.
interaction: Builds a number and then partitions it a second way.

objective: Compare and order numbers to 100 using <, > and =
animation: 47 and 74 are built side by side; the rods line up first, so the side with more tens wins, whatever the ones.
interaction: Compares two numbers by building them, then places the < or > sign.

objective: Place and estimate numbers on a 0-100 number line
masteryCheck: Marks 70 roughly in the right place on a blank 0-100 line
animation: A 0-100 line zooms; halfway is marked 50, then the line splits into tenths; 70 slides into place.
interaction: Drags numbers onto an empty line and sees how close they are.

objective: Read and write numbers to 100 in words
animation: 'Sixty-eight' is spoken and builds 6 rods and 8 cubes as each part of the word is said.
interaction: Writes the word for a built number.

objective: Recall addition and subtraction facts to 20 fluently; derive related facts to 100 (3 + 4 = 7 so 30 + 40 = 70)
masteryCheck: Answers 20 mixed facts in one minute
animation: 3 + 4 = 7 in cubes, then each cube grows into a ten rod: 30 + 40 = 70.
interaction: Turns a known fact into a tens fact.

objective: Add and subtract: 2-digit and 1-digit, 2-digit and tens, two 2-digit numbers, three 1-digit numbers
animation: 46 + 27: ones join to make 13; ten of them snap into a new rod (exchange) and move to the tens.
interaction: Adds and subtracts with blocks, doing the exchange by hand.

objective: Know addition is commutative and subtraction is not
masteryCheck: Says why 9 - 3 is not the same as 3 - 9
animation: 3 + 9 and 9 + 3 land on the same point of the line. 9 - 3 works, but 3 - 9 runs out of counters.
interaction: Tests whether swapping numbers changes the answer.

objective: Use inverse relationships and fact families to check calculations
animation: A part-whole triangle with 6, 8 and 14 spins to show four facts: two additions and two subtractions.
interaction: Writes all four facts from one picture.

objective: Know pairs of multiples of 10 that make 100 (70 + 30)
animation: Ten rods make 100; 7 rods slide left and 3 right, showing 70 + 30.

objective: Solve two-step word problems with a bar model (part-whole and comparison)
masteryCheck: Draws and solves a two-step comparison problem
animation: A two-step story plays; the bars build in two steps, the first answer feeding the second bar.
interaction: Builds a two-step bar model and labels the unknown.

objective: Recall the 2, 5 and 10 times tables; recognise odd and even numbers
masteryCheck: Answers mixed ×2, ×5, ×10 facts in 3 seconds each
animation: Hands of 5 appear one by one in a row while the count of 5s climbs; 2s light every other square.
interaction: Answers facts and sees the array for each one.

objective: Understand multiplication as repeated addition and arrays; know it is commutative
animation: 4 rows of 3 rotate a quarter turn to become 3 rows of 4; the total stays 12.
interaction: Builds an array and rotates it.

objective: Understand division as sharing and as grouping; write ×, ÷ and = statements
masteryCheck: Shows 12 ÷ 3 both as sharing and grouping
animation: 12 sweets share into 3 bags one at a time (sharing), then group into bags of 3 (grouping); both show 4.
interaction: Uses both sharing and grouping on the same problem.

objective: Solve multiplication and division problems in context
masteryCheck: Solves 'How many bags of 5 from 30 apples?'
animation: 30 apples drop into bags of 5, with each full bag counted 5, 10, 15 ...
interaction: Chooses grouping or sharing for a story.

objective: Know all times tables to 9 × 9 (Japanese kuku, Grade 2)
animation: 7 x 8 appears as an array split into 5 x 8 and 2 x 8; the parts glow and add.
interaction: Builds a times-table fact as an array and splits it into easier facts.

objective: Find and name 1/3, 1/4, 2/4 and 3/4 of a length, shape or set; know 2/4 = 1/2
animation: 12 counters arrange into 4 equal groups; 3 of the groups light up. Then a strip folds into quarters and 2/4 covers exactly 1/2.
interaction: Finds fractions of shapes and sets.

objective: Choose units and measure length (cm, m), mass (kg, g), temperature (°C) and capacity (l, ml)
masteryCheck: Reads a scale to the nearest labelled unit
animation: A ruler slides under an object from the 0 mark; the end lines up and the reading pops up. Scales and jugs work the same way.

objective: Compare and order lengths, mass and capacity using <, > and =
animation: Three jugs pour into identical glasses side by side so their heights can be compared.

objective: Use £ and p; combine coins to make amounts; find change
masteryCheck: Makes 37p in two ways; finds change from 50p
animation: 37p is built from coins; then 20p, 10p, 5p and 2p swap for other coins making the same total.
interaction: Pays an amount in two ways and gives change.

objective: Tell time to 5 minutes, including quarter past and quarter to; know minutes in an hour, hours in a day
animation: The minute hand sweeps in 5-minute jumps while a counter counts in 5s. Quarter past paints a quarter of the face.
interaction: Sets the clock to a spoken time.

objective: Describe 2D shapes by sides and vertical line symmetry
masteryCheck: Counts sides and finds the mirror line
animation: A mirror line slides across a shape; the shape folds over the line and matches exactly, or does not.
interaction: Finds lines of symmetry by folding.

objective: Describe 3D shapes by edges, vertices and faces
animation: A cube spins with its edges glowing one by one, then its vertices pulse, then its faces fill with colour.
interaction: Counts edges, vertices and faces by tapping them.

objective: Describe rotations as clockwise and anticlockwise turns; know a quarter turn is a right angle
masteryCheck: Turns a shape a quarter turn clockwise
animation: A shape turns clockwise like the clock hands; a quarter turn leaves a right-angle corner mark.

objective: Compose and split shapes; mentally rotate and fit shapes (tangrams, pentominoes)
animation: Tangram pieces fly into an outline; one piece spins and flips until it fits.

objective: Read and make tally charts, pictograms, block diagrams and tables
masteryCheck: Answers 'how many more' questions from a pictogram
animation: Pets walk into a pictogram row by row; tallies are scratched, then bundled into gates of 5.
interaction: Builds a pictogram from objects and answers questions.

objective: Solve missing-number sentences with a box as the unknown (? + 7 = 15)
animation: ? + 7 = 15 sits on a balance; 7 is taken from both sides and the box is left equal to 8.

objective: Reason about always / sometimes / never statements
masteryCheck: Decides 'odd + odd is always even' and shows why
animation: Odd towers (with one sticking-out cube) join in pairs; the two loose cubes always click together.

objective: Count in 4s, 8s, 50s and 100s; find 10 or 100 more or less
animation: A number gains 100 more: a hundred flat drops onto its blocks and only the hundreds digit changes.
interaction: Adds or takes 10 or 100 and sees which digit changes.

objective: Know place value in three-digit numbers; compare and order to 1000
masteryCheck: Shows 305 with counters and explains the zero
animation: 305 is built with 3 flats and 5 cubes; the empty tens column glows to show what the zero means.

objective: Read and write numbers to 1000 in numerals and words
animation: Each part of 'six hundred and eight' drops into its column.
interaction: Writes numbers from blocks and words.

objective: Show numbers to 1000 on a soroban (Japanese abacus)
animation: Beads flick up and down to set 472; the heaven bead counts 5.

objective: Add and subtract mentally: a three-digit number and ones, tens or hundreds
animation: 456 + 30: three rods slide in; only the tens column changes.
interaction: Solves mental additions with blocks shown faintly.

objective: Use column addition and subtraction up to three digits, with exchanging
visualModel: Place-value counters beside the written column
animation: 503 - 267: with no tens to exchange, a hundred flat breaks into ten rods and one rod breaks into ten ones. Each exchange appears in the written column at the same time.
interaction: Does the column method with counters synced to the written digits.

objective: Estimate answers and use inverse operations to check
animation: 298 slides to 300 and 405 to 400, and the estimate appears next to the exact answer.

objective: Solve missing-number and multi-step problems
animation: A multi-step problem builds bar by bar; the unknown is a question-marked bar.

objective: Recall the 3, 4 and 8 times tables
masteryCheck: Answers mixed ×3, ×4, ×8 facts in 3 seconds each
animation: An array of 2s doubles to 4s, then to 8s, the rows copying themselves.
interaction: Uses doubling to find x4 and x8 facts.

objective: Multiply a two-digit by a one-digit number, mental to formal
animation: 23 x 4: four rows of 2 rods and 3 cubes; the rods and cubes separate into 80 and 12, which add.
interaction: Splits the rectangle and fills the parts.

objective: Divide a two-digit by a one-digit number mentally and with jottings
animation: 48 counters share into 4 groups: tens first, then ones.

objective: Solve scaling and correspondence problems (3 hats and 4 coats make 12 outfits)
animation: 3 hats and 4 coats combine; each hat draws lines to every coat, making a grid of 12 outfits.
interaction: Lists all combinations in a table.

objective: Count up and down in tenths; know tenths come from dividing by 10
visualModel: Fraction strips in tenths, number line
animation: A whole strip splits into 10 parts; tenths hop along the line to 10/10, which is 1.
interaction: Counts in tenths on the line.

objective: Find unit and non-unit fractions of a set of objects
animation: 20 counters drop into a bar split in 5; two parts light up showing 8.
interaction: Finds fractions of amounts with the bar.

objective: Place fractions on a number line and treat them as numbers
animation: Fraction strips lie on a number line; the ends of the strips become points like 3/4.
interaction: Places fractions on a number line.

objective: Recognise equivalent fractions with small denominators
animation: 1/3 lies on the fraction wall; two 1/6 pieces slide under it and match exactly.
interaction: Finds equivalent fractions on the wall.

objective: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator within one whole
animation: 2/7 and 3/7 strips join end to end into 5/7.

objective: Compare and order unit fractions and fractions with the same denominator
animation: A cake cut into 8 and one cut into 5: the 1/8 slice is visibly smaller.

objective: Measure, compare, add and subtract lengths (m, cm, mm), mass and capacity
animation: 1 m 20 cm and 45 cm lie end to end on a metre stick.

objective: Measure the perimeter of simple 2D shapes
visualModel: String round a shape, squared paper
masteryCheck: Finds the perimeter of a rectangle
animation: A string traces round a rectangle, then pulls straight along a ruler.

objective: Add and subtract amounts of money and give change
animation: £5 pays for £3.65; coins count up from £3.65 to £5.

objective: Tell time on analogue clocks with Roman numerals I-XII and on 12- and 24-hour clocks; use seconds, am/pm, days in each month
masteryCheck: Reads a time on a Roman-numeral clock
animation: A 24-hour ring wraps round the 12-hour clock; afternoon numbers light up.

objective: Draw 2D shapes and make 3D shapes
animation: Straws and putty assemble into a cuboid edge by edge.

objective: Recognise angles as turns and as properties of shapes; identify right angles and angles greater or smaller
masteryCheck: Sorts angles against a right-angle checker
animation: An arm turns from a point and the sweep grows; a right-angle corner checker snaps on at a quarter turn.
interaction: Turns arms to make angles bigger or smaller than a right angle.

objective: Identify horizontal, vertical, perpendicular and parallel lines
masteryCheck: Finds parallel lines in a classroom photo
animation: Train tracks slide forever and never meet (parallel); two roads cross with a square corner (perpendicular).

objective: Interpret and present data in bar charts, pictograms and tables
masteryCheck: Answers two-step questions from a bar chart
animation: Pictogram icons stack and melt into a bar chart with a scale in 2s.
interaction: Builds a bar chart and reads values between marks.

objective: Describe a pattern or rule in words and use a symbol for an unknown
masteryCheck: Says how many cubes in the 10th pattern
animation: A growing cube pattern adds one L-shape each step; a table fills alongside.
interaction: Predicts and builds the next steps.

objective: Try several approaches to a non-routine problem and compare them (structured problem solving)
visualModel: Japanese lesson structure: problem, try, share, compare
masteryCheck: Finds two methods and says which is more efficient
animation: Three children solve the same problem with different pictures; the pictures line up to compare them.
interaction: Solves a problem two ways and picks the neatest.

objective: Count in multiples of 6, 7, 9, 25 and 1000; find 1000 more or less
animation: Jumps of 25 on a line make four jumps per 100, like coins in £1.

objective: Count backwards through zero to include negative numbers
animation: A thermometer cools; the red line drops past 0 into negative numbers.

objective: Know place value in four-digit numbers; order and compare beyond 1000
animation: Thousands, hundreds, tens and ones columns fill; numbers are compared column by column from the left.

objective: Round any number to the nearest 10, 100 or 1000
animation: 3650 sits between 3000 and 4000; it rolls downhill to the nearer thousand.
interaction: Rounds by placing on a hill-shaped line.

objective: Read Roman numerals to 100 and know how the system changed over time
animation: Roman symbols stack: X X X X then turn into XL with a subtracting arrow.

objective: Use column addition and subtraction with up to four digits
animation: 4005 - 1738: exchanges cascade across the zeros, synced with the written column.
interaction: Does column calculations with exchanges shown.

objective: Solve two-step problems, choosing operations and methods
masteryCheck: Explains why they chose each operation
animation: Two-step problem bars build, then the operation for each step lights up.

objective: Recall all multiplication and division facts to 12 × 12
visualModel: Arrays, area grid, games with spaced practice
animation: Every fact shows as an array on a 12 x 12 grid; 7 x 8 is shown inside 7 x 10 with a strip taken away.
interaction: Practises facts with the array available, then faded.

objective: Multiply by 0 and 1, divide by 1, multiply three numbers together
masteryCheck: Solves 2 × 6 × 5 by choosing a good order
animation: 2 x 6 x 5 turns into a 3D block of cubes; turning the block shows 10 x 6.

objective: Use factor pairs and the distributive law in mental calculation (39 × 7 = 40 × 7 - 7)
animation: 39 x 7 appears as 40 x 7 with a thin strip of 1 x 7 removed.
interaction: Adjusts and compensates on the area model.

objective: Use short multiplication for two- and three-digit numbers by a one-digit number
animation: 346 x 7: hundreds, tens and ones each copy 7 times; exchanges ripple up, synced with the written method.
interaction: Does short multiplication with the model.

objective: Solve integer scaling and harder correspondence problems
masteryCheck: Solves 'a giraffe is 4 times as tall as a 1.3 m child'
